description:
I don’t think I’m from this era...!“ On the day everyone wears a larval suit and holds a traditional freshman welcome, Chae-won finds a male student who is faithful to his past Confucian concept, speaking and speaking. Chaewon is helped by a male student in a daze... But a boy who thought it was a conceptworm is actually a Korean who has been at time slip?! The story of Chae-won, a freshman in college, and Ha-jin, a Confucian scholar of the Joseon Dynasty!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/56180828), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/scholar_from_joseon), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=5665358), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/505025523)
